purpose: Teach: カンファレンス/コマーシャル/プロバイダー/申し入れ/立候補/過半数/申立/処遇

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界カンファレンスでよく講演されたぞ
lines.en: Father, you spoke often at industry conferences.
lines.style: Quiet nostalgia. Soft, measured pace. Each phrase lands with gentle weight, like recalling a detail you've held for years. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはコマーシャルの威力を見抜かれました
lines.en: Yes. Father, you had a way of seeing the real power of good communication.
lines.style: Respectful, steady tone. Voice carries weight but not heaviness. Speaking as one aware of a legacy. Slight pause before 'communication,' honoring the thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、回線プロバイダーの選定にも関与されたぞ
lines.en: Father, you were involved in every choice we made about our infrastructure.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Slow cadence, like turning over a memory. Voice soft but clear. The specificity of 'every choice' carries meaning — he didn't delegate this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の申し入れを真摯に受け止めた
lines.en: Yes. Father, you took every staff concern seriously — you listened without dismissing.
lines.style: Warm but formal. Voice carries the weight of someone speaking truthfully about someone he respected. Slight emphasis on 'seriously,' grounding the sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは「立候補は責任を伴う」と仰った
lines.en: Father used to say: 'If you accept a nomination, you accept responsibility with it.'
lines.style: Quoting, but not performatively. Voice drops slightly, becomes more intimate. Speaking words that still matter. Slight pause after the colon, letting it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは過半数の同意を得る丁寧さがあった
lines.en: Yes. Father, you made sure everyone had a real voice — you sought their consent carefully.
lines.style: Reflective, honest. Voice steady and clear. Speaking about a principle he valued. Not self-congratulatory, just truthful. Slight rise on 'carefully,' affirming it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員からの申立を丁寧に扱われたぞ
lines.en: Father, you treated every request from the staff with real dignity.
lines.style: Appreciative, measured. Voice warm but not sentimental. Each word deliberate. The kind of observation someone makes when they've watched someone do something well over many years.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、社員の処遇改善に尽力されました
lines.en: Yes. Father devoted himself to making sure our people were cared for and valued.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Voice carries the finality of someone summing up a life well-lived. Steady, unblushing. Not regretful, just clear about what mattered.
